from AlgorithmImports import *


class ExactStrategyAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.required_symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma_200 = SimpleMovingAverage(200)
        self.spy_sma_50 = SimpleMovingAverage(50)
        self.aapl_rsi_14 = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.spy_previous_close = None
        self.spy_previous_sma_200 = None
        self.spy_previous_sma_50 = None

        self.aapl_previous_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        available = {}

        for symbol in self.required_symbols:
            if data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
                available[symbol] = data.Bars[symbol]
            else:
                available[symbol] = None

        if available[self.spy] is None:
            self.spy_previous_close = None
            self.spy_previous_sma_200 = None
            self.spy_previous_sma_50 = None

        if available[self.aapl] is None:
            self.aapl_previous_close = None
            self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        spy_bar = available[self.spy]
        if spy_bar is not None:
            self.spy_previous_sma_200 = (
                float(self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value)
                if self.spy_sma_200.IsReady else None
            )
            self.spy_previous_sma_50 = (
                float(self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value)
                if self.spy_sma_50.IsReady else None
            )

            self.spy_sma_200.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, float(spy_bar.Close))
            self.spy_sma_50.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, float(spy_bar.Close))

        aapl_bar = available[self.aapl]
        if aapl_bar is not None:
            if self.aapl_previous_close is None:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            elif float(aapl_bar.Close) < self.aapl_previous_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.aapl_rsi_14.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, float(aapl_bar.Close))

        if spy_bar is not None:
            current_spy_close = float(spy_bar.Close)
            previous_spy_close = self.spy_previous_close

            strategy_a_buy = (
                previous_spy_close is not None
                and self.spy_previous_sma_200 is not None
                and self.spy_sma_200.IsReady
                and previous_spy_close <= self.spy_previous_sma_200
                and current_spy_close > float(self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value)
            )

            strategy_a_sell = (
                previous_spy_close is not None
                and self.spy_previous_sma_50 is not None
                and self.spy_sma_50.IsReady
                and previous_spy_close >= self.spy_previous_sma_50
                and current_spy_close < float(self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value)
            )
        else:
            strategy_a_buy = False
            strategy_a_sell = False

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            strategy_b_buy = (
                self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
            )

            strategy_b_sell = (
                self.aapl_rsi_14.IsReady
                and float(self.aapl_rsi_14.Current.Value) > 60
            )
        else:
            strategy_b_buy = False
            strategy_b_sell = False

        if not all(available[symbol] is not None for symbol in self.required_symbols):
            if spy_bar is not None:
                self.spy_previous_close = float(spy_bar.Close)
            if aapl_bar is not None:
                self.aapl_previous_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)
            return

        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and strategy_a_sell:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and strategy_b_sell:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and strategy_a_buy:
            price = float(spy_bar.Close)
            quantity = int((0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue)) // price)
            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and strategy_b_buy:
            price = float(aapl_bar.Close)
            if float(self.Portfolio.Cash) >= 20000:
                quantity = int(20000 // price)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

        self.spy_previous_close = float(spy_bar.Close)
        self.aapl_previous_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)

class StrategySystemAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.spy_sma_200 = self.SMA(self.spy, 200, Resolution.Daily)
        self.spy_sma_50 = self.SMA(self.spy, 50, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi_14 = self.RSI(
            self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.spy_lot = 0
        self.aapl_lot = 0
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_200 = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_50 = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None

        self.SetWarmUp(200, Resolution.Daily)

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        available_symbols = [
            self.spy,
            self.aapl,
            self.ibm,
            self.bac,
            self.aig,
        ]

        present = {
            symbol: symbol in data.Bars
            for symbol in available_symbols
        }

        if present[self.aapl]:
            aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

        if present[self.spy]:
            spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close

            if self.spy_sma_200.IsReady:
                self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
                self.previous_spy_sma_200 = self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value

            if self.spy_sma_50.IsReady:
                self.previous_spy_sma_50 = self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            return

        if not all(present.values()):
            return

        if not (
            self.spy_sma_200.IsReady
            and self.spy_sma_50.IsReady
            and self.aapl_rsi_14.IsReady
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma_200 is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma_50 is not None
        ):
            return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close

        current_spy_sma_200 = self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value
        current_spy_sma_50 = self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value
        current_aapl_rsi = self.aapl_rsi_14.Current.Value

        strategy_a_buy = (
            self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma_200
            and spy_close > current_spy_sma_200
        )

        strategy_a_sell = (
            self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma_50
            and spy_close < current_spy_sma_50
        )

        strategy_b_buy = self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
        strategy_b_sell = current_aapl_rsi > 60

        if self.spy_lot > 0 and strategy_a_sell:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.spy_lot)
            self.spy_lot = 0

        if self.aapl_lot > 0 and strategy_b_sell:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.aapl_lot)
            self.aapl_lot = 0

        if self.spy_lot == 0 and strategy_a_buy:
            shares = math.floor(
                (self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / spy_close
            )
            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                self.spy_lot = shares

        if self.aapl_lot == 0 and strategy_b_buy:

                shares = math.floor(20000 / aapl_close)

        self.previous_spy_close = spy_close
        self.previous_spy_sma_200 = current_spy_sma_200
        self.previous_spy_sma_50 = current_spy_sma_50

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma_200 = SimpleMovingAverage(200)
        self.spy_sma_50 = SimpleMovingAverage(50)
        self.aapl_rsi_14 = RelativeStrengthIndex(14)

        self.spy_lot = 0
        self.aapl_lot = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_200 = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_50 = None

        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.SetWarmUp(200, Resolution.Daily)

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        previous_sma_200 = (
            self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value
            if self.spy_sma_200.IsReady
            else None
        )
        previous_sma_50 = (
            self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value
            if self.spy_sma_50.IsReady
            else None
        )

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy):
            spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
            self.spy_sma_200.Update(data.Bars[self.spy].EndTime, spy_close)
            self.spy_sma_50.Update(data.Bars[self.spy].EndTime, spy_close)

            if self.previous_spy_close is not None:
                pass

            self.previous_spy_close = spy_close

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]
            aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close
            self.aapl_rsi_14.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_close)

            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            self.previous_spy_sma_200 = (
                self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value
                if self.spy_sma_200.IsReady
                else None
            )
            self.previous_spy_sma_50 = (
                self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value
                if self.spy_sma_50.IsReady
                else None
            )

            self.previous_spy_sma_200 = (
                self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value
                if self.spy_sma_200.IsReady
                else None
            )
            self.previous_spy_sma_50 = (
                self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value
                if self.spy_sma_50.IsReady
                else None
            )
            return

        current_sma_200 = self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value
        current_sma_50 = self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value

        spy_buy_reason = (
            self.spy_sma_200.IsReady
            and self.previous_spy_sma_200 is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma_200
            and spy_close > current_sma_200
        )

        spy_sell_reason = (
            self.spy_sma_50.IsReady
            and self.previous_spy_sma_50 is not None
            and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma_50
            and spy_close < current_sma_50
        )

        if self.spy_lot > 0 and spy_sell_reason:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.spy_lot)
            self.spy_lot = 0

        if self.aapl_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi_14.IsReady:
            if self.aapl_rsi_14.Current.Value > 60:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.aapl_lot)
                self.aapl_lot = 0

        if self.spy_lot == 0 and spy_buy_reason:
            quantity = int(
                (0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) / spy_close
            )
            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.spy_lot = quantity

        if self.aapl_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                quantity = int(20000 / aapl_close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
